## Description

No real data exists yet, so delete the 46 SQL Server migrations and create one baseline migration per module on Postgres (schemas per module kept). From then on migrations are forward-only and reviewed. Regenerate the ERD (`python3 -I tools/erd/generate.py`), update the seeder and the dev database. Merge freeze on schema-changing PRs from the moment this starts until it merges.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an empty Postgres database, when migrations run, then every module schema exists from its single baseline.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the ERD, when the baseline merges, then `docs/03-architecture/erd.md` is regenerated and CI is green.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a schema-changing PR, when is open during the freeze, then it is rebased onto the baseline before merge.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
